notes: Expansion paired with grammar-replace-0008 (a unit after a number in a hyphenated compound takes its plural form). Fictional subject: a made-up class of units newly defined in one craft's jargon (zelbrask units) under the real class 'unit of measurement', given the revision's new conclusion in an empty slot; the real units (mile, foot) are left alone. Derived queries name made-up units (grimnet, vorskin, brunzel) with the membership in the prompt. Near unrelated: the real unit 'foot' ('a ten-foot ladder'); a rule that leaks to every unit answers 'a ten-feet ladder'. Caveat: the made-up class sits under a real class whose real rule (units in a hyphenated compound stay singular) already fills this slot by inheritance, so before the edit a model would give the old conclusion for its members; the 'empty slot' is closer to an exception to an inherited rule than to a pure expansion.
